verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or any identity-provider integration, and nothing shows admin policy enforcement requiring hardware-key authentication. The pack documents only general FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkey, PIV and OTP capabilities, plus developer SDKs and attestation primitives. Those are building blocks or adjacent features, not this story's capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication
